userRequest: Continued work on reported story bugs, retaining the user earlier instruction to package updates as a normal small version instead of a repair-labeled build. This local 0.1.15 package contains the confirmed shared-station fix and diagnostic logging; the newly reported map visibility issue is explicitly unresolved.
scope: Shared Crossroads station refresh and native Crossroads map purchase. Two isolated localhost clients, memory-only heroes, all SaveGame overloads intercepted. Entry/control, payment, repeated offers, active render mesh/alpha and two later room snapshots. Not a full release suite or two-machine FRP validation.
